verdict.rationale: WooCommerce documents native MCP support enabling AI assistants/tools to interact directly with the store (product discovery, cart/checkout via Store API endpoints) rather than scraping, per developer.woocommerce.com/docs/features/mcp/ and probe confirmation of the live doc page. Missing for 10: no independent/hands-on verification of an agent actually completing a discover-and-cart flow via the MCP endpoint, and no detail on UCP support or production-scale usage evidence.
